subject: AWS Marketplace private offer - buyer approvals & preferred term for Clearsight pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@clearsight.ai>, procurement@clearsight.ai
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace private offer - buyer approvals & preferred term for Clearsight pilot

Hi Ethan / Clearsight procurement team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited about the pilot prospect. To move the AWS Marketplace private offer (MPO) forward I want to confirm two things so we can prepare the draft PO and HubSpot/DocuSign flow:

1) Preferred term length for the pilot purchase: 12 months versus longer (24/36 months). We have different pricing buckets and activation requirements for multi-year commitments.
2) Exact approval path on your side: who needs to sign (procurement contact, finance/CFO, security/compliance), and any thresholds that trigger an executive sign-off. You mentioned security will review SaaS integrations. Can you confirm timeline?

I've attached an initial MPO draft (Redwood_MPO_Draft_4821.pdf) and a short pricing comparison.

We can propose a 12-month pilot with an option-to-extend/conversion clause to avoid blocking procurement, or a discounted 36-month upfront if finance prefers longer commitments. Also want to confirm whether Clearsight will need co-sell entitlements as part of the Marketplace listing (we can coordinate AWS co-sell onboarding but it requires the listing to be live + partner designation).

Next steps: if you can share the procurement template (or any internal PO form) we'll insert the buyer approval info and send a DocuSign-ready MPO.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: Redwood_MPO_Draft_4821.pdf
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@clearsight.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearsight.ai
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer - buyer approvals & preferred term for Clearsight pilot

Hi Chloe,

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers:

- Term: Procurement preference is 12 months for pilot purchases under $150k. For multi-year (2-3 year) deals we need CFO approval and centralized budget sign-off.
- Approvals: procurement@clearsight.ai + Finance (CFO) for >$100k; Security team to review SaaS data handling and logging (they typically request SOC2 and network diagrams). Our security lead is Sara Diaz (sara.diaz@clearsight.ai) — I can loop her in if you share the evidence pack.

We do have an internal PO template — attaching it here (Clearsight_PO_Template.docx).

On co-sell: a co-sell request would be great, but we need the AWS listing active and the MPO properly structured. If a multi-year price discount is available that would help the internal procurement/business case.

I'll aim to get procurement's recommended timeline tomorrow morning.

Best,
Ethan
Director, Platform Partnerships
Clearsight AI

Attachment: Clearsight_PO_Template.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 12:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer - buyer approvals & preferred term for Clearsight pilot

Chloe / Jonas —

Thanks for the thread. A few recommendations from pricing and co-sell ops:

- Term guidance: Redwood standard MPO supports 12, 24, 36 month options. Discounting steps: ~10% at 24 months, ~18% at 36 months (ballpark; will confirm with finance). For a pilot we often propose 12M with an explicit conversion/renewal credit to make it an easier procurement lift.
- Approver risk: If their CFO is involved we should expect a 7–14 day turnaround after submission if proc+finance are aligned; security reviews can add 10–21 days depending on SLAs. Provide SOC2 report and network architecture to speed security clearance.
- Co-sell: AWS co-sell support requires the Marketplace listing to be active and 'Seller' co-sell status enabled; we can offer seller-led co-sell assistance but mark it contingent on AWS vetting. Draft MPO should include a clause that activation of co-sell benefits is contingent on AWS approvals.

I'll attach a quick pricing_comparison.csv with the three term scenarios for the deal. Chloe — propose we send the 12M MPO first with optional 24M conversion language. If procurement pushes for a 36M discount, route to Finance for pre-approval.

-Vivek
Head of Sales Operations (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_comparison.csv
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer - buyer approvals & preferred term for Clearsight pilot

Chloe / Vivek —

Good plan. Chloe, please prepare an MPO that: (1) names procurement@clearsight.ai as buyer, (2) includes a clear approval path section (procurement -> finance -> security), and (3) has the optional conversion language Vivek suggested. Also include the co-sell contingency language.

Kimberly — can you review for any legal flags on multi-year conversion language and pro-rated refund mechanics? If there's a specific redline you'd like us to include in the MPO we can pre-seed it.

I'll stand by to help escalate finance approvals if procurement needs it.

Thanks,
Jonas

Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer - buyer approvals & preferred term for Clearsight pilot

Jonas / Chloe —

Legal take:

- 12 month pilot with option-to-convert is preferred from a risk perspective. We can entertain a 36 month MPO only with explicit CFO pre-approval and finance sign-off; otherwise we expose Redwood to legacy discounting that is hard to unwind.
- Include a termination-for-convenience clause with pro-rated refund for unused period and a clause limiting liability tied to our SOC2 scope.
- For Marketplace/Private Offer specifically, add a paragraph that any co-sell entitlements or AWS-managed credits are subject to AWS approval and are not Redwood obligations.
- Security evidence: link to our SOC2 + security pack is fine for them to use (https://drive.redwood.com/legal/mpo-redline-4821).

I'll draft a short redline and upload to the Drive link above. Chloe — once you have the MPO with the approval path inserted, send it to me and I'll redline for legal.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
